checklist: Is the remote MCP server official, verified, or organization-owned?
Does connector configuration use HTTPS server_url?
Is require_approval explicitly set for high-impact tool calls?
Are OAuth scopes least-privilege and time-bound?
Is data sent to remote MCP server minimized and logged?
Are tool outputs treated as untrusted model context?
Are allowed tools constrained to the business workflow?
Is there an audit trail for tool calls and user approval?
